items.question: What languages does SAIZUP AI support?
items.answer: SAIZUP AI specializes in Lao, Thai, and English language support for AI transcription and subtitles. We're continuously working to add more languages.

items.question: Is my video data safe?
items.answer: Yes! Your videos are processed entirely in your browser. We only send small audio clips to our AI for transcription. Your video files never leave your device.

items.question: Can I export videos without a watermark?
items.answer: Free trial exports include a small watermark. Pro subscribers can export completely watermark-free videos.

items.question: What video formats are supported?
items.answer: SAIZUP AI supports MP4, MOV, WebM, and most common video formats. All exports are optimized for vertical 9:16 format perfect for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No! SAIZUP AI runs entirely in your web browser. No downloads or installations required. Just sign up and start editing.
